specification.population: Exact original eligible-issuance HGB forecasts, same driver strictly later next eligible completed lap, unchanged targets/legacy80 features. No checkpoint-population expansion.
specification.baseline: Strong production architecture HGB:15leaves,150iterations,absolute_error,.06learningrate,minleaf80,L2=10,early_stoppingfalse,random_state20260907; coefficients fit only2022 for2023selection, with event-balanced training and original ±5s target/±3s prediction residual clips. Reuse verified checkpoint base_2022 artifact if identical.
specification.weather_clock: Raw weather and lap Time are recorded session-clock seconds. No scheduled-start, green-flag, timezone or GMT-offset adjustment.
specification.primary_asof_rule: Weather.Time strictly less than issuance.Time−60seconds;60s is an added delivery-lag assumption, not verified receipt latency. Equal timestamps excluded.

feature_contract.last_known: Each channel carries only its own last finite observation strictly before the cutoff, with its own age/missingness. Values older than600seconds at issuance are unavailable; no backward fills or interpolation.
feature_contract.history: Causal5-minute per-minute slopes for AirTemp,Humidity,Pressure,TrackTemp,WindSpeed using last finite record before cutoff and last finite record before cutoff−300s; explicit support. Latest observed positive Rainfall age, observed rain sample fractions/counts and change counts over past15minutes; only timestamps before cutoff.
feature_contract.wind: sin/cos of observed direction in degrees and speed-weighted components, with availability indicators; no arithmetic mean of angles.
feature_contract.rain_gate: At least one observed Rainfall=1 record with issuance.Time−900 <= weather.Time < issuance.Time−60. Uses only weather history, never target flags or future track status.
feature_contract.no_weather_fallback: All variants return exact base point when every current weather channel is unavailable. Rain-gated variants additionally return exact base point when rain gate is false.
feature_contract.immutability: Legacy80 feature values and target columns must remain exactly unchanged when adding weather columns. No event/driver identity, future targets or full-event weather statistics enter the model.

family.weights: Equal event total weight over original eligible targets, including weather-missing events.

specification.partition: Fit2022, select2023 minimum original-population event-balanced MAE with fixed grid order for ties. No2024–26 acquisition or scoring unless advancement screen passes. All2023variant results reported, no additional search.
specification.receipt_lag_sensitivity: Re-encode2023features with lag0s and120s for the selected60s-trained model only, without refit or candidate/lag reselection.
specification.reporting: 20000paired event and circular3-event block bootstrap resamples, per-event andLOO, whole original population plus observed weather-rain and dry/no-recent-rain subsets. Report matched/issued coverage and channel ages/missingness. Previously exposed retrospective discovery, not prospective validation; no production promotion.
specification.constraints: OneCPU, at most4variants/twoaugmentedfits, no neuralmodels, production/git edits or unapproved later-season acquisition. Root owns weather acquisition; model source/artifacts stay under weather/model.
